description: This script generates wrapper source files and configuration files for the XNNPACK library, based on CMakeLists and other source lists. It automates the creation of platform-specific wrapper includes and updates related .bzl configuration files.

methods.name: handle_singleline_parse
methods.description: Parses a single line of CMake code to extract the key and list of values.

methods.name: update_sources
methods.description: Reads a CMakeLists.txt or similar file to extract source file names and associated conditions.

methods.name: gen_wrappers
methods.description: Generates wrapper source files and updates .bzl configuration files based on source lists.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that triggers wrapper generation based on command-line arguments.
